target_customer: Omnichannel consumer packaged goods brands with inventory, co-manufacturers and ERPs
problem: CPG brands plan supply in spreadsheets and chase supplier emails. Spherecast's AI agent Agnes forecasts, plans inventory and processes supplier updates.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription with 30 day money back guarantee after onboarding (company site)
product_category: AI supply chain planning for consumer goods

founders.name: Leon Hergert
education: Technical University of Munich, information systems
founders.background_notes: Supply chain and logistics planning in aviation and e commerce (YC page); employers not named.

founders.name: Paul Dietrich
founders.background_notes: Full stack developer and designer (YC page).

founders.name: Pascal Schindler
education: University of British Columbia, research on non-linear optimization (degree not listed)
founders.background_notes: Built robotics automation at Deadalus (YC page).

technical_complexity.rationale: Forecasting, ERP integration and LLM based exception handling across messy supply chain data is standard but integration heavy engineering.

defensibility.rationale: ERP integrations and planning workflows create some lock in, but several inventory planning tools already existed and AI agents are easy to imitate.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Established planning vendors and ERPs were adding AI features; no sourced action against Spherecast.

market_need_then: CPG brands rely on spreadsheets for planning; customers named on the site (Mammaly, AG1, prohealth, RYSE, HOLY) give some demand evidence, though the dates are not given.

identity.mascot_or_character: Agnes, the named AI supply chain manager
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and somewhat playful: Focus on exceptions, not spreadsheets; we cover the coffee

branding.brand_signature: Agnes as a named AI manager and the Conscious Supply Chain newsletter
branding.community_and_virality: A beehiiv newsletter called Conscious Supply Chain; no merch or fan community found.

brand_strength.rationale: Named agent and playful voice help, but the name is confusable with Sphere and Agnes AI and no press on the brand exists.

pivots.to: Agnes, AI supply chain manager for consumer goods
pivots.why: Repositioning shown by changing profile descriptions; no stated reason and the date is approximate

outcome_analysis: Spherecast is a three founder German led YC S24 company building an AI supply chain planner for CPG brands. It repositioned from an inventory copilot to a broader supply chain manager and lists several brand customers, but only small team size and a single aggregator pre seed figure were found. No exit or shutdown was reported, and the funding record is too thin to judge performance.
notes: Clera lists $1.5M raised with a pre seed in Dec 2024 and another job board says about $500K; both single aggregator figures, unverified and not recorded as rounds. A critical hiring site profile questions scale claims. Competitors left empty: only undated vendor comparison pages (Prediko, Cogsy, Inventory Planner) were found, none dated near the batch. Founders Dietrich and Schindler are listed on the YC page.
